AccentRule.description: Short 4px marketing accent bar used under section titles.

props.name: disableGutters
props.description: Remove the gap between items and stack them as a single surface.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: value
props.deprecated: Prefer wrapping with AccordionItem — value is inherited.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing action (button, close).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Tones get a default icon so status is not conveyed by colour alone; pass `null` to hide.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called when Escape would dismiss the alert. `event.preventDefault()` keeps it open.

AmountInput.description: Currency-prefixed amount field for finance forms.

AnnouncementPill.description: The small "what's new" pill above a hero headline. Links when you give it an `href`.

props.name: hideChevron
props.description: Hide the trailing chevron on a linked pill.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the pill a link and shows a chevron.

props.name: tag
props.description: Short leading label — "New", "v2.0", "Changelog".

AppHeader.description: Top application chrome — glass header with brand, optional hamburger, actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-side actions

props.name: children
props.description: Center / search slot

props.name: variant
props.description:
`sticky` — in-flow glass bar.
`chrome` — fixed safe-area app chrome (journalD RootLayout).

AppShell.description:
Application frame: sidebar + top bar + content, with intentional mobile behaviour —
the sidebar becomes a sheet, and an optional bottom bar takes over primary navigation.

props.name: density
props.description: Region density — `compact` suits admin consoles and data tools.

props.name: layout
props.description:
`inset` — content sits on a raised panel beside the sidebar (the Spatika default).
`flush` — sidebar and content share the canvas, separated by a hairline.

props.name: mobileNav
props.description: Bottom navigation for phones (e.g. `MobileTabBar`).

props.name: mobileNavBreakpoint
props.description:
Width at which the real sidebar takes over from the bottom bar + drawer.
`lg` (default, 1024px) — unchanged, matches existing shells.
`md` (768px) — tablets get the persistent sidebar; only phones (<768px) see `mobileNav`.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Usually a `<Sidebar>`. Rendered as a rail from `mobileNavBreakpoint` up, and inside a sheet below.

props.name: topbar
props.description: Usually a `<TopBar>`.

AppSidebar.description: Data-driven navigation sidebar. For composable shells prefer `AppShell` + `Sidebar` + `NavItem`.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Collapsed icon rail.

props.name: connectNulls
props.description: Default `connectNulls` for series that do not set their own.

ArticleCard.description:
One entry in a blog, changelog or press listing — cover, title, excerpt and a byline.
Pair it with `Prose` for the post body itself.

props.name: author
props.description: Author name.

props.name: authorAvatar
props.description: An `Avatar` or `InitialsAvatar`.

props.name: date
props.description: Publication date — pass a formatted string, or a `<time>` element.

props.name: excerpt
props.description: Standfirst or excerpt. Clamped to three lines.

props.name: featured
props.description: Bigger type for the lead story in a listing.

props.name: href
props.description: Link for the whole card. The title carries the link so the accessible name is right.

props.name: media
props.description: Cover image or illustration.

props.name: readingTime
props.description: "6 min read".

props.name: tags
props.description: Category or tags — `Tag` elements, usually.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` — hairline surface · `plain` — no box · `horizontal` — media beside the copy.

AspectRatio.description: Reserves space for media before it loads, so images and embeds never shift the layout.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width / height, e.g. `16 / 9`. Default 16/9.

Autocomplete.description: Filterable combobox. Supports single, multiple, and free-solo entry.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((value: string | string[] | null, option?: AutocompleteOption | AutocompleteOption[] | null) => void)

AvailabilityBadge.description: Pill badge with a live pip — “available for work” treatment.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatar stack with an overflow count.

Backdrop.description: Full-viewport dimmer, typically paired with a modal or speed dial.

props.name: contained
props.description: Render in-place instead of portaling to document.body.

props.name: invisible
props.description: Skip the dimmed fill — useful as a click-catcher.

props.name: dot
props.description: Leading status dot in the badge colour.

BentoCard.description:
One tile in a `BentoGrid`. Tiles carry their own span, so the grid reads as a
deliberate composition rather than an even matrix.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Tints the tile with the accent — use it on exactly one tile per grid.

props.name: media
props.description: Visual that fills the rest of the tile — a chart, screenshot or schematic.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows to span at the large breakpoint.

props.name: shine
props.description: Sweeps a facet highlight across the tile on hover.

props.name: span
props.description: Columns to span at the large breakpoint (1–3).

BentoGrid.description:
Asymmetric tile layout for a product overview — a few big tiles, a few small ones.
Give tiles a `span` so the composition has a clear focal point.

props.name: columns
props.description: Track count at the large breakpoint.

BottomSheet.description:
Glass bottom sheet (Vaul) — mobile filters, overflow menus, sheet panels.
Customize surface via className; defaults match app chrome glass-panel look.

Box.description: Generic layout primitive. Prefer Stack / Grid / Paper for structured layouts.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis when there are more than this many.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label (replaced by the spinner while loading).

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows a spinner and ignores activation, so a form cannot be submitted twice. The button
keeps keyboard focus (it is `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`) and announces `aria-busy`.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered after the label.

ButtonBase.description: Unstyled pressable — MUI ButtonBase analogue. Use Button / IconButton for styled actions.

ButtonGroup.description: Connected cluster of buttons — first/last corners stay rounded.

Calendar.description:
Month grid following the WAI-ARIA date-picker grid pattern: one tab stop, arrows move by
day / week, Home / End to the start / end of the week, PageUp / PageDown by month
(Shift for a year), Enter / Space selects. Single dates or ranges; range mode previews the
span while you hover or arrow toward the end date.

props.name: autoFocusDay
props.description: Mark the focusable day with `data-autofocus` so a popover opens onto it.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Return true to disable a day (weekends, holidays, booked dates).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable day.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable day.

props.name: month
props.description: First visible month (controlled).

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months shown side by side (they wrap when the container is narrow). Default 1.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 = Sunday (default), 1 = Monday.

props.name: series
props.type: { id?: string; label?: string; color?: string; data: Array<CandleDatum | null>; }[]

Card.description: Container for a discrete object (an account, a chart, a record). Sections of a page do not need a card.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as another element (`section`, `article`, `li`).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Adds hover / focus affordances for clickable cards.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state (accent border).

props.name: surface
props.description:
Surface material. `default` is solid; `glass` is translucent and meant for
cards that float over imagery or media.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing control(s) aligned to the title row.

CareerCard.description: Resume / experience card: role, company, period pill, bullets, tech tags.

CareerTimeline.description: Vertical career rail with a hairline and slot for CareerCard rows.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Seed hover at this category index.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Message when every visible series is empty. Default `"No data"`.

props.name: fillHeight
props.description: When true, plot height follows the parent instead of the numeric `height`.

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Where the series legend sits. Default `top`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Cover the plot while data is fetching.

props.name: maxBarSize
props.description: Cap bar thickness in px (Recharts `maxBarSize`).

props.name: minPointSize
props.description: Minimum bar thickness in px so near-zero values stay visible.

props.name: sharedTooltip
props.description: Show every series at the hovered category. Default true.

props.name: showBarBackground
props.description: Category tracks behind bars (Recharts `Bar` `background`).

props.name: showCursor
props.description: Vertical guide at the active category. Default true.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Draw the numeric value at the end of each bar.

props.name: stackOffset
props.description: Stacking strategy when `stacked` is set. `expand` is 100% stacked.

props.name: syncId
props.description: Link hover with other charts that share this id (Recharts `syncId`).

props.name: tooltipTrigger
props.description: Open the tooltip on hover or click (Recharts Tooltip `trigger`).

Chip.description: Toggleable chip for filters, preferences, and layout switches.

props.name: showCheck
props.description: Show a check mark when active (filter chips).

ChipGroup.description: Titled multi-select chip row used in admin preferences and filter panels.

props.name: variant
props.description: filter = soft pills, preference = uppercase admin chips

ChromeAttachedCaret.description:
Small pointer that visually joins a popover to its trigger.
`align="end"` matches popover `align="end"` (caret sits under the right-hand control).

CircularProgress.description: Circular indicator. Indeterminate spins; determinate fills an SVG track.

ClickAwayListener.description: Invokes `onClickAway` when a pointer event occurs outside the child.

Collapse.description:
Height collapse used by Accordion and other expandable regions.
Animates `grid-template-rows` (transform-safe; no `transition-all`).

props.name: in
props.description: When true, the child is expanded.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Keep children mounted while collapsed. Defaults to true so height can animate.

Combobox.description: Filterable combobox. Supports single, multiple, and free-solo entry.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((value: string | string[] | null, option?: AutocompleteOption | AutocompleteOption[] | null) => void)

CommandFooter.description: Hint row at the bottom of a palette (keyboard legend).

CommandPalette.description: Data-driven command palette on top of `CommandDialog`. Pair with `SearchTrigger` for ⌘K.

props.name: footer
props.description: Show the keyboard legend.

CommandSearchField.description: Inline global search with a results dropdown. For a modal palette use `CommandPalette`.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when clear is pressed

ComparisonTable.description:
Feature matrix for a pricing page or an "us vs them" comparison — plans across the top,
features down the side.

It renders a real `table` with row headers, and booleans get a visually hidden
"Included" / "Not included" so the grid is not just a field of icons to a screen reader.
The table scrolls inside its own container, so the page never scrolls sideways.

props.name: caption
props.description: Describes the table for screen readers. Visually hidden.

props.name: featureLabel
props.description: Header for the first column.

props.name: groups
props.description: Sectioned features — "Collaboration", "Security", "Support".

props.name: rows
props.description: Flat list of features. Use `groups` instead when the list needs sections.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keep the column header row visible while the table scrolls.

ComposedChart.description: Mixed bar/line/area plot — Recharts `ComposedChart` alias of `ChartContainer`.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Seed hover at this category index.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Message when every visible series is empty. Default `"No data"`.

props.name: fillHeight
props.description: When true, plot height follows the parent instead of the numeric `height`.

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Where the series legend sits. Default `top`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Cover the plot while data is fetching.

props.name: maxBarSize
props.description: Cap bar thickness in px (Recharts `maxBarSize`).

props.name: minPointSize
props.description: Minimum bar thickness in px so near-zero values stay visible.

props.name: sharedTooltip
props.description: Show every series at the hovered category. Default true.

props.name: showBarBackground
props.description: Category tracks behind bars (Recharts `Bar` `background`).

props.name: showCursor
props.description: Vertical guide at the active category. Default true.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Draw the numeric value at the end of each bar.

props.name: stackOffset
props.description: Stacking strategy when `stacked` is set. `expand` is 100% stacked.

props.name: syncId
props.description: Link hover with other charts that share this id (Recharts `syncId`).

props.name: tooltipTrigger
props.description: Open the tooltip on hover or click (Recharts Tooltip `trigger`).

ContactLink.description: Contact / social row: tinted icon well, name, handle, trailing arrow.

ContextMenu.description:
Right-click menu for a region. Shares DropdownMenu's content and items
(`ContextMenuContent` = `DropdownMenuContent`, use `DropdownMenuItem` etc. inside) and its
keyboard model. Keyboard users open it with Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key; touch users
with a long press.

ContextMenuContent.description: Content for `ContextMenu` — identical to `DropdownMenuContent`, opened at the pointer.

CoverHero.description:
Cover hero — generated / photo cover that bleeds into app chrome, floating
glass controls, a notched identity plate, and a compact sticky bar once the
hero scrolls away. Mirrors journalD StoryCoverHeader / Profile hero.

props.name: bleed
props.description: When false, keep the cover inside this frame (docs / device previews).

props.name: compactOffsetClassName
props.description: Offset used when the compact bar pins under app chrome.

props.name: variant
props.description: Profile bleeds into a tab bar; story ends at the identity plate.

CoverPattern.description:
Seeded nature-inspired cover when no cover photo is set.
Scene kind is unique per seed; colors follow hue + theme.

CtaBand.description: The closing ask of a marketing page — one headline, one line of copy, one action.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions — one primary, at most one secondary.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Decorative backdrop inside the band.

props.name: description
props.description: One line of copy. A CTA band is not the place for a paragraph.

props.name: layout
props.description: `split` puts actions beside the copy on wide screens; `stacked` centres everything.

props.name: note
props.description: Fine print under the actions.

props.name: tone
props.description: `surface` — hairline card · `accent` — accent gradient · `inverse` — dark slab.

DataTable.description:
Professional data table: density, sorting, selection with bulk actions, pinned columns,
sticky header, expandable rows, inline actions, pagination, loading / empty states,
and a stacked list layout on phones. Rows stay rows — never cards.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the table.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Rendered in the bar that replaces the toolbar while rows are selected.

props.name: hiddenColumns
props.description: Ids of hidden columns (controlled). Pair with `DataTableColumnsMenu` in the toolbar.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Sorting happens outside (server).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Scroll height for the body (enables sticky header scrolling).

props.name: responsive
props.description: `list` (default) stacks rows into a list on phones; `scroll` keeps the table with horizontal scroll.

props.name: rowActions
props.description: Inline actions revealed on row hover / focus (always visible on touch).

props.name: totalRows
props.description: Total rows when paginating on the server.

DataTableColumnsMenu.description:
"Columns" menu for a DataTable toolbar: a checkbox per column that toggles `hiddenColumns`.
Columns with `hideable: false` stay listed but cannot be hidden, and the last visible
column can never be turned off.

props.name: columns
props.type: { id: string; header: ReactNode; hideable?: boolean; }[]

DataTableToolbar.description: Search + filter slot + actions row above data tables.

DatePicker.description:
Single-date field: a button that opens a Calendar in a popover. Selecting a day closes it
and returns focus to the field; the calendar opens on the selected (or current) day.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a Clear action in the popover.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options for the trigger text. Default `{ dateStyle: "medium" }`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — submits ISO dates (`yyyy-mm-dd`).

DateRangePicker.description:
Date-range field: pick a start then an end day (the span previews as you hover or arrow).
Optional presets sit beside the calendar and apply in one click.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a Clear action in the popover.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options for the trigger text. Default `{ dateStyle: "medium" }`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — submits ISO dates (`yyyy-mm-dd`).

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months side by side. Default 2 (they stack when the popover is narrow).

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick ranges shown beside the calendar: "Last 7 days", "This month" …

Delta.description: Signed change indicator with arrow + colour + screen-reader wording.

props.name: value
props.description: Change value. With `format="percent"`, `0.042` renders as `+4.2%`.

props.name: intent
props.description:
`normal`: up is good (revenue). `inverse`: up is bad (costs, churn, latency).
Colour follows intent; the arrow always follows the number.

props.name: label
props.description: Override the rendered text.

DescriptionItemRow.description: One term / value pair — compose these as children for custom content.

DescriptionList.description:
Label–value pairs for record details (a customer's plan, a transaction's metadata). Uses
`<dl>` semantics so screen readers announce each term with its value.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns for `layout="grid"`. Default 2.

props.name: layout
props.description:
`auto` (default) stacks term over value and switches to side-by-side once the list itself
is ≥ 28rem wide; `stacked` always stacks; `grid` flows items into columns at ≥ 40rem.
Breakpoints are container queries, so the same list adapts inside a sheet, card or page.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular numerals for every value.

props.name: hideClose
props.description: Hide the built-in close button (provide your own `DialogClose`).

props.name: mobileLayout
props.description: Keep the centred dialog on phones instead of the bottom-sheet transformation.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called when Escape would close the dialog. `event.preventDefault()` keeps it open.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Called when the scrim is clicked. `event.preventDefault()` keeps the dialog open.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the scrim.

props.name: position
props.description: `top` anchors near the top of the viewport (command palettes, search).

DisplayHeading.description: Oversized marketing hero title. Compose with Wordmark / GradientText.

Drawer.description:
Vaul drawer root.
Disable background scaling + input repositioning by default — both break
touch hit-testing on iOS Safari / PWAs after the page has been scrolled.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Radix-compatible selection handler. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep
the menu open (e.g. editor formatting actions that must retain focus).

EmptyState.description: Zero-state for lists, tables and dashboards. Explains what goes here and how to start.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Primary action shortcut.

props.name: actions
props.description: Custom action row (overrides `actionLabel`).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 3.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colours the icon well: `neutral` (default) for empty lists, the others for outcomes.

props.name: variant
props.description: `bordered` draws a dashed well; `plain` sits directly on the page / inside a table.

EntityCard.description: Glass surface wrapper for entity list items.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered HTML element. Defaults to `div`.

props.name: density
props.description: Slightly denser padding for compact lists.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Soft hover lift for interactive rows (navigation / selection).

EntityCardChip.description: Compact type / status chip for entity cards.

EntityCardMeta.description: Secondary / muted line under the title.

EntityMediaCard.description: Entity card with photo (or generated cover + initials) — contact / album tile.

props.name: fallbackLabel
props.description: Initials when no image

EventCalendar.description: Month / week / day / agenda calendar with editor, resize, recurrence, and preferences.

props.name: onSlotClick
props.type: ((slot: { start: Date; end: Date; allDay: boolean; }) => void)

props.name: onVisibleRangeChange
props.description: Fires when the painted date window changes. `end` is exclusive.

props.name: renderEvent
props.description: Replace event chip contents. The kit still wraps with the click/drag trigger.

props.name: renderToolbar
props.description: Replace the toolbar. The default kit toolbar is used when omitted.

props.name: showDateJump
props.description: Month/year native selects on the default toolbar. Ignored when `renderToolbar` is set.

props.name: showEventEditor
props.description:
Built-in create/edit dialog. Defaults to true.
Set false when the host owns create/edit (custom schedule modal, etc.).

props.name: showPreferences
props.description: Preferences gear in the default toolbar. Ignored when `renderToolbar` is set.

props.name: toolbarDensity
props.description: Default toolbar layout. Compact is a single desktop row. Ignored when `renderToolbar` is set.

props.name: toolbarTrailing
props.description: Extra controls after the view menu. Ignored when `renderToolbar` is set.

props.name: yearOptions
props.description: Years in the date-jump select. Defaults to a window around the current year.

EventTimeline.description: Horizontal resource timeline — rows are resources, bars are allocations across time.

props.name: showEventEditor
props.description:
Built-in create/edit dialog. Defaults to true.
Set false when the host owns create/edit.

Fab.description: Floating action button. Use `variant="extended"` for a labeled FAB.

FaqSection.description:
Frequently asked questions on an `Accordion`. Set `structuredData` to also emit
FAQPage JSON-LD — the markup search engines read for rich results.

props.name: aside
props.description: Aside beside the list on wide screens — support links, contact card.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Question opened on first render.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the title — often a "still stuck? talk to us" pointer.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Let several answers stay open at once.

props.name: structuredData
props.description:
Emit FAQPage JSON-LD alongside the list. Only answers that are plain strings are
included, since structured data cannot carry markup.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the list.

FeatureCard.description: One feature: icon, title, a sentence of copy, and an optional link.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing link — "Read the guide".

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences. Longer than that belongs on its own page.

props.name: href
props.description: Wraps the card in a link and adds hover lift.

props.name: icon
props.description: Usually a lucide icon or an `IconTile`.

props.name: media
props.description: Screenshot, chart or illustration above the copy.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`plain` — copy only · `card` — solid surface · `outline` — hairline only ·
`rail` — accent rail on the leading edge (the prism motif).

FeatureGrid.description: Responsive grid of `FeatureCard`s — the standard "what you get" block.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as a list — use with `FeatureCard as="li"` when the features are an inventory.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns at the large breakpoint. Always one column on phones.

FileUpload.description:
Drag-and-drop file picker with validation and a file list. The drop zone wraps a real
file input, so it is keyboard- and screen-reader-operable and works in plain forms.
Uploading is up to you: pass `progress` and `errors` keyed by `fileKey(file)`.

props.name: accept
props.description: Same syntax as the native `accept` attribute: `image/*,.pdf`.

props.name: errors
props.description: Per-file error keyed by `fileKey(file)`.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Bytes per file.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — the native input carries the files for plain form posts.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with each batch of rejected files.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The accepted file list after a selection, drop or removal.

props.name: progress
props.description: Upload progress (0–100) keyed by `fileKey(file)` — the list shows a bar while < 100.

FilledInput.description: Filled field — quieter fill, no resting border. For dense toolbars and inline filters.

FilterSheet.description: Responsive filter panel used by directory, history, and similar list pages.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Desktop / `md+` control — typically a `Button` using `floatingPageChromePillClass`.

props.name: mobileTrigger
props.description: Optional compact control for small screens; defaults to `trigger` if omitted.

FloatChip.description: Frosted floating fact chip used around a marketing hero portrait.

props.name: float
props.description: CSS float animation.

props.name: live
props.description: Compact live row (green pip + uppercase label) instead of title/subtitle.

FloatingPageChromeBar.description:
Shared chrome row: identity, optional centered search, trailing actions.
`below` is a second row (mobile search, compact TOC) and is not itself a full-bleed bar.
Pass `children` to pin this bar above a nested scroller (content never slides under it).

props.name: children
props.description: Page body — scrolls independently so it cannot pass under the toolbar.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Spoken name for the count badge, e.g. "253 people".

FloatingPageChromeSearchField.description: Search pill used in the chrome row and the mobile reveal row.

FloatingPageChromeShell.description: Shell + glass tray for pages that compose the chrome row by hand.

FormControlLabel.description: Pairs a checkbox, radio, or switch with its visible label.

FormErrorSummary.description:
Lists every validation error after a submit, each linking to its field. Focus moves to the
summary so keyboard and screen-reader users hear how many problems there are, then follow a
link to fix each one. Pair with `FormField` errors for the inline message.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus to the summary when errors appear (after submit). Default true.

FormField.description:
Label + control + help/error. Wires `id`, `aria-labelledby` (for controls a `<label>` cannot
name, such as radio groups), `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required` onto a
single child control automatically. Errors are announced politely as they change.

props.name: id
props.description: Id for the control. Generated when omitted and injected into the child if it has none.

props.name: labelAction
props.description: Trailing element on the label row, e.g. a "Forgot password?" link.

props.name: layout
props.description: `horizontal` puts the label in a left column at ≥640px (settings pages).

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows "Optional" beside the label (use instead of marking every other field required).

GradientText.description: Theme-colored gradient type for wordmarks and display names.

props.name: variant
props.description: `static` clips a 3-stop theme gradient; `flow` animates it.

Grid.description: 12-column CSS grid. Use `container` on the parent and breakpoint spans on items.

HeaderIconButton.description:
Square frosted toolbar control used in sticky headers and app chrome.
Fully customizable via className; children typically an icon.

props.name: badge
props.description: Unread / status count shown as a pill

IconButton.description: Icon-only control. Always pass `aria-label` (or a visually hidden label child).

IconTile.description: Horizontal domain / feature tile: icon well + italic title + caption.

props.name: title
props.type: string | (string & React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>>) | (string & Iterable<React.ReactNode>) | (string & React.ReactPortal) | (string & Promise<AwaitedReactNode>)

InitialsAvatar.description:
Plain initials circle — use when {@link AvatarFallback} would stay hidden
without an image load cycle (e.g. no {@link AvatarImage} child).

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper when `leading` / `trailing` are used.

props.name: leading
props.description: Content rendered inside the field before the input (icon, currency, prefix).

props.name: size
props.description:
Control height (`sm` · `md` · `lg` · `touch`). Defaults to the density token.
A number is forwarded as the native `size` attribute for compatibility.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content rendered inside the field after the input (unit, shortcut, clear button).

props.name: variant
props.description: Borderless field for toolbars and inline editing.

LeadForm.description:
Email capture for a marketing page — the newsletter row under a hero, the waitlist
block, the "talk to us" form. Pass extra fields as `children` and they submit with it.

Status is uncontrolled by default: if `onSubmit` returns a promise, the button shows a
pending state and the success message is announced politely when it resolves.

props.name: action
props.description: Submit button copy.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra fields (name, company, a textarea) rendered above the email row.

props.name: formAction
props.description: Native form action — for a Formspree / Mailchimp style endpoint.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Visible unless `hideLabel`, but always announced.

props.name: layout
props.description: `inline` puts the field and button on one row; `stacked` is full width.

props.name: message
props.description: Message shown under the form after success or failure.

props.name: note
props.description: Fine print under the form — consent, frequency, "no spam".

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called with the email (and the form element, for extra fields you passed as
`children`). Return a promise and the button shows a pending state on its own.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. Leave unset and the form tracks its own.

props.name: successMessage
props.description: Message announced on success when you have not passed `message`.

props.name: connectNulls
props.description: Default `connectNulls` for series that do not set their own.

LogoCloud.description:
Customer or integration logos. Greyscale by default so the row reads as texture and
the page's own accent stays dominant; individual logos come to colour on hover.

props.name: children
props.description: The logos — `img`, inline `svg` or plain wordmark text.

props.name: height
props.description: Cap on logo height.

props.name: label
props.description: Line above the row — "Trusted by teams at".

props.name: plain
props.description: Keep logos in full colour instead of the default greyscale-until-hover.

props.name: variant
props.description: `row` wraps in a centred flex row; `marquee` scrolls continuously.

MarketingHero.description:
The top of a marketing page: announcement, headline, lede, calls to action and an
optional product shot. `layout="split"` puts the media beside the copy on wide screens
and stacks it underneath on phones.

props.name: actions
props.description: Call-to-action buttons.

props.name: align
props.description: Copy alignment. Defaults to centred when stacked, start-aligned when split.

props.name: announcement
props.description: Usually an `AnnouncementPill`, above everything else.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level. Use `h1` once per page.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small label above the title.

props.name: footer
props.description: Trust strip under the hero — a `LogoCloud`, rating row or stat line.

props.name: layout
props.description: `stacked` centres the copy with media below; `split` puts media beside it.

props.name: lede
props.description: Sub-headline. Keep it to a sentence or two — the measure is capped for readability.

props.name: media
props.description: Product shot, `ShowcaseFrame`, illustration or form.

props.name: note
props.description: Fine print under the actions — "No card required", "MIT licensed".

MarketingSection.description:
Full-bleed band of a marketing page: background tone, generous vertical rhythm, an
optional decorative backdrop, and a centred max-width container for the content.

This is the marketing counterpart to `PageSection` — reach for `PageSection` inside
product screens, and for this on landing, pricing and story pages.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Decorative backdrop — pass a kind, or an options object.

props.name: edge
props.description: Hairline separators between stacked sections.

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the inner max-width container.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Vertical rhythm. `tight` halves the section padding, `none` removes it.

props.name: tone
props.description: Background material. `inverse` and `accent` flip the ink for everything inside.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width. `narrow` suits long-form copy; `full` opts out of the inner container.

Marquee.description:
Continuously scrolling row for logos or short quotes. The track is duplicated so the
loop is seamless; the copy is hidden from assistive tech. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` it stops and wraps into a static, centred row.

props.name: direction
props.description: Scroll direction.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full pass. Longer is calmer.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause while the pointer is over the row.

Masonry.description: CSS multi-column masonry. Children should be block-level items.

MediaEntryCard.description:
Long horizontal entry card (story / activity style) with optional side media.
All content regions are slots for full customization.

props.name: accentClassName
props.description: Soft accent stripe when no image

props.name: mediaClassName
props.description: Override media width on sm+

props.name: anchorEl
props.description: Anchor element — typically the button that opened the menu.

MetaChip.description: Compact “powered by” chip: icon + label with a quiet ring.

Metric.description: Typography-led KPI. No container — place inside a `Card`, `MetricGroup`, or directly in a page.

props.name: value
props.description: Number (formatted with `format`) or pre-rendered value.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing element in the label row (menu, info tooltip).

props.name: caption
props.description: Comparison caption, e.g. "vs last month".

props.name: chart
props.description: Visual below the value — typically a `SparkLineChart` or `Progress`.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change vs. comparison period. Number → `<Delta>`; node → rendered as-is.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon beside the label.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit suffix rendered quieter than the value (`ms`, `GB`, `/mo`).

MetricGroup.description: Row of metrics that reads as one summary strip. Wrap in a `Card` for a boxed strip.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns at desktop width. Collapses to two on phones.

props.name: divided
props.description: Hairline dividers between metrics instead of gaps — reads as one strip.

MobileTabBar.description:
Floating bottom navigation for phones. One of the places Spatika uses translucent
material: it floats over scrolling content. Hidden from `lg` up, where the sidebar takes over.

props.name: contained
props.description:
Position inside a parent instead of the viewport, and keep the bar visible
on large screens (docs previews, device frames).

props.name: hidden
props.description: Slide the bar away (e.g. while a text field is focused on iOS).

props.name: trailing
props.description: Extra trailing control (e.g. More)

Modal.description: Low-level modal. Prefer Dialog for titled confirmations.

NativeSelect.description: Styled native `<select>` — prefer compound `Select` for custom menus.

props.name: size
props.description:
Visual size. `default` stays full-width for forms.
`sm` is a compact pill for toolbars. `touch` is a 44px target.
Omits the native HTML `size` (visible option rows) to avoid the clash.

NavItem.description: Sidebar navigation row with the prism-rail active state. Collapses to an icon with tooltip.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (e.g. a router `Link`) with nav-item styling.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target — renders an `<a>`. For router links use `asChild`.

props.name: meta
props.description: Count or badge after the label.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing action on the section title (add, filter).

NoSsr.description: Renders children only after mount — useful for browser-only APIs.

NotificationBell.description: Notification trigger with an anchored inbox panel.

NumberInput.description:
Numeric field with the WAI-ARIA spinbutton keyboard model: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step,
PageUp / PageDown (or Shift+Arrow) take a large step, Home / End jump to min / max.
Free typing is allowed; the value is parsed, clamped and rounded on blur or Enter, and
shown with `formatOptions` while the field is not being edited.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Display format while the field is not being edited, e.g. `{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }`.

props.name: hideSteppers
props.description: Hide the increment / decrement buttons.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: PageUp / PageDown and Shift+Arrow. Default `step × 10`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Content inside the field before the number (unit, icon).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the committed number, or `null` when the field is cleared.

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places kept on commit. Defaults to the precision of `step`.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow keys and steppers. Default 1.

props.name: series
props.type: { id?: string; label?: string; color?: string; data: Array<CandleDatum | null>; }[]

OtpInput.description:
One-time-code entry. Each character has its own cell; typing advances, Backspace steps
back, arrows move, and pasting (or SMS autofill via `autocomplete="one-time-code"`) fills
every cell at once.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the group. Default "Verification code".

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Render a separator after every `groupSize` cells (e.g. 3 → `123–456`).

props.name: length
props.description: Number of characters. Default 6.

props.name: mask
props.description: Obscure entered characters.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when every cell is filled.

props.name: type
props.description: `numeric` (default) accepts digits; `alphanumeric` accepts letters and digits.

PageHeader.description: Page title block. Actions collapse beneath the title on narrow screens.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Hairline under the header (use when tabs sit beneath).

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: Breadcrumb rendered above the title.

props.name: children
props.description: Content under the header row — tabs, filters.

props.name: kicker
props.description: Small context line above the title (section name, record type).

props.name: meta
props.description: Inline metadata after the title (badge, status, count).

PageSection.description:
Typography-led page section. Groups content with a heading and spacing instead of
wrapping it in a card — use this for most page structure.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls aligned with the section title (filters, "View all").

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level for the title.

props.name: divider
props.description: Hairline above the section — separates without boxing.

PageShell.description: Page frame on the canvas colour.

props.name: contained
props.description: Constrain content width (`--spk-page-max`).

props.name: padded
props.description: Include horizontal page padding.

PageStickyHeader.description:
Sticky glass page chrome — title, icon badge, search & action slots.
Matches journalD PageHeader (density, count, below row, page-header-* type).

props.name: below
props.description: Full-width row under the main toolbar (mobile search / secondary actions).

props.name: offsetClassName
props.description: Offset below a fixed app bar (defaults to top-16 → --app-chrome-offset).

props.name: title
props.type: string | (string & React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>>) | (string & Iterable<React.ReactNode>) | (string & React.ReactPortal) | (string & Promise<AwaitedReactNode>)

props.name: page
props.description: 1-based current page.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown either side of the current page in `pages` mode.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`pages` — numbered buttons with ellipses (default ≥640px).
`compact` — "Page 3 of 12" with arrows (default on phones, dense toolbars).

Panel.description:
Bordered container with a header bar. Use for objects that need their own frame:
a chart, a data table, a feed.

props.name: actions
props.description: Header controls (segmented period, menu).

props.name: flush
props.description: Remove body padding — for tables and lists that run edge to edge.

Paper.description: Low-level surface primitive. Prefer `Card` for structured content.

props.name: elevation
props.description: 0–3. Ignored when variant is outlined.

PhotoViewer.description: Full-screen photo viewer / lightbox with zoom and prev/next.

props.name: labelFormatter
props.type: ((item: { label: string; value: number; percent: number; }) => string | null)
props.description: Return slice label text, or null to hide. Defaults to percent when the slice is large enough.

props.name: labelLine
props.description: Draw leader lines to labels outside the ring (Recharts Pie `labelLine`).

props.name: series
props.type: { data: Array<{ id?: string | number; value: number; label?: string; color?: string; }>; innerRadius?: number; paddingAngle?: number; }[]

PinPad.description: Numeric PIN pad with dot indicators. Length, copy, and styles are customizable.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Called before focus returns to the trigger on close. `event.preventDefault()` skips it.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description:
Called before focus moves into the content on open. `event.preventDefault()` keeps focus
on the trigger (Tab from the trigger still enters the popover).

Portal.description:
Renders children into `document.body` (or a provided container) via React portal.
Mounts synchronously on the client so floating content can be measured in the
same layout pass (avoids width=0 positioning flashes).

PresenceDot.description: Live status pip with optional ping halo (availability badges, hero chips).

props.name: ping
props.description: Dual-span scale ping. Defaults to true.

props.name: name
props.description: Plan name — "Free", "Team", "Enterprise".

props.name: price
props.description: The headline number. Pass a string so you control currency and formatting.

props.name: action
props.description: The plan's call to action — a `Button`, usually full width.

props.name: badge
props.description: Ribbon on a featured plan — "Most popular".

props.name: description
props.description: One line on who the plan is for.

props.name: featured
props.description: Lifts and rings the plan you want people to pick.

props.name: features
props.description: Plan contents. Strings are shorthand for `{ label }`.

props.name: note
props.description: Fine print under the action.

props.name: period
props.description: What the price is per — "/month", "per seat / month".

PricingTable.description:
Row of plans. Featured plans lift above the row on wide screens, so keep the plan
you want chosen in the middle.

props.name: columns
props.description: Plans per row at the large breakpoint.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Billing switch or note above the plans — a `SegmentedControl`, usually.

ProfileHero.description:
Profile / entity hero: cover fills the frame, overlapping avatar notches
the frosted identity plate. Stacked in a narrow column; left-notched once
the plate is wide enough (container query, not viewport).

props.name: bleed
props.description: When false, keep the cover inside this frame (catalog previews).

props.name: coverSeed
props.description: Seed for the generated cover when no photo is set.

ProjectCard.description: Marketing project tile: title, company, outcome pill, body, tech tags.

Prose.description:
Long-form typography for posts, changelogs, docs and legal pages: headings, lists,
quotes, code and figures styled from the theme with a capped measure.

`html` is injected as-is — only pass markup you have sanitised or authored yourself.

props.name: html
props.description: Render pre-sanitised HTML — for MDX output or a CMS body.

props.name: lead
props.description: Set the first paragraph at title size as a standfirst.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` is the reading default; `sm` suits sidebars and changelog entries.

QuickFilterRail.description: Horizontal scroll filter rail with optional grouped sections.

props.name: activeStyle
props.description: solid = filled primary when active (directory style); soft = tinted (default chip)

QuickSettings.description: Sliding quick-settings panel — appearance, density, toggles, etc.

props.name: side
props.description: side sheet from right (default) or bottom drawer-like panel

Rating.description: Star rating. `StarRating` is the same component with a required `value`.

ResizablePanels.description:
Split view with draggable, keyboard-operable dividers (WAI-ARIA window splitter). Each
divider is a focusable `separator`: arrows resize, Home / End jump to the limits. Sizes are
percentages, can persist across visits, and panels stack on narrow containers.

props.name: defaultSizes
props.description: Initial sizes in percent, one per panel. Default: equal.

props.name: handleLabels
props.description: Accessible names for the handles, one per gap. Default "Resize".

props.name: keyboardStep
props.description: Percent moved per arrow key press. Default 5.

props.name: minSizes
props.description: Minimum size per panel in percent. Default 10.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` puts panels side by side (default); `vertical` stacks them.

props.name: sizes
props.description: Controlled sizes in percent.

props.name: stackBelow
props.description:
Below this container width (px) horizontal panels stack vertically without handles —
split views rarely make sense on a phone. Default 640.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Persist sizes in localStorage under this key.

ResponsiveContainer.description:
Fill the parent the way Recharts `ResponsiveContainer` does.
Injects `fillHeight` on a single chart child so the plot tracks the box.

props.name: aspect
props.description: CSS aspect ratio (width / height), e.g. `1.6`.

ResultState.description:
Outcome of an action or page load — "Payment received", "Export failed", "You don't have
access". Announced politely (`role="status"`) and coloured by status, never by colour alone:
each status has its own icon and the title states the outcome.

props.name: status
props.description: Outcome being reported.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Primary action shortcut.

props.name: actions
props.description: Custom action row (overrides `actionLabel`).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 3.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default status icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: `bordered` draws a dashed well; `plain` sits directly on the page / inside a table.

Reveal.description:
Plays a short entrance the first time its content scrolls into view.

Motion is the one thing a landing page can overdo, so this stays deliberately small:
opacity plus a few pixels of travel. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the transition is
dropped entirely and content renders in place — and it renders visible when
`IntersectionObserver` is unavailable (SSR, older engines, jsdom).

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds — stagger a row by passing `index * 80`.

props.name: effect
props.description: How the element arrives.

props.name: once
props.description: Replay every time the element re-enters the viewport.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before it plays.

SchedulerDateJump.description: Compact month/year native selects for calendar toolbars.

props.name: dateJump
props.description: Month/year jump. Sits beside the view menu.

props.name: density
props.description: Compact is a single desktop row. Defaults keep the stacked marketing toolbar.

ScrollArea.description:
Native scroll container with thin, theme-coloured scrollbars and contained overscroll.
It stays a real scroller (wheel, touch, keyboard and find-in-page work) and becomes a
focusable region so keyboard users can scroll content that has no focusable children.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the top and bottom edges to hint at more content.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height (vertical) — a number is pixels.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Restrict scrolling to one axis. Default `vertical`.

SearchField.description: Search input with leading icon — mobile-friendly min height.

SearchInput.description: Search input with leading icon — mobile-friendly min height.

SearchTrigger.description: Field-shaped button that opens a command palette.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Opens the palette. Also fired by the ⌘K / Ctrl+K hotkey when `hotkey` is on.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls aligned with the section title (filters, "View all").

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level for the title.

props.name: divider
props.description: Hairline above the section — separates without boxing.

SectionBackdrop.description:
Decorative layer for a marketing section — purely presentational and token-derived, so
it retints with the theme. Sits behind `MarketingSection` content automatically.

props.name: animated
props.description: Slow drift on `aurora` and `glow`. Ignored under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: kind
props.description:
`aurora` — two soft accent fields · `glow` — one spotlight behind a centred hero ·
`grid` / `dots` — hairline pattern that fades at the edges · `rays` — a faint prism fan.

props.name: strength
props.description: Multiplier on the backdrop opacity. Drop it below 1 on busy sections.

SectionHeading.description:
Marketing / page-section title: optional eyebrow, heading, subtitle, and accent rule.
Renders a `div` (not `<header>`) so it never competes with the site navbar.

props.name: showRule
props.description: Hide the accent rule under the copy.

SectionPanel.description: Settings / admin section in a bordered panel: header row, then content.

SegmentedControl.description: Single-select segmented toggle (period, view mode). Arrow keys move selection.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to fill the container.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called when Escape would close the sheet. `event.preventDefault()` keeps it open.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Called when the scrim is clicked. `event.preventDefault()` keeps the sheet open.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the scrim.

ShowcaseFrame.description:
Chrome around a product screenshot, live demo or video. Everything is drawn from
tokens, so the frame follows the active theme instead of shipping a light-mode PNG.

props.name: bodyClassName
props.description: Classes for the content area inside the chrome.

props.name: chrome
props.description: `browser` — dots and a URL pill · `window` — dots only · `phone` — device bezel · `none` — bare.

props.name: shine
props.description: Sweep a facet highlight across the frame on hover.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Perspective tilt — turns a flat screenshot into an object on the page.

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown in the window bar when there is no URL.

props.name: url
props.description: URL shown in the browser bar.

props.name: footer
props.description: Bottom slot — `UserMenu`, help, settings.

props.name: header
props.description: Top slot — `WorkspaceSwitcher` or a brand mark.

SiteFooter.description:
Marketing-site footer. Two shapes from one component:

- **Slim** (default) — brand, copyright, a link row and optional meta chips.
- **Tall** — pass `columns` for a sitemap footer with a brand column, an optional
  `description`, an `action` slot for a signup form, `social` links and a `legal` row.

props.name: action
props.description: Slot beside the brand — a `LeadForm`, usually.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Sitemap columns. Passing these switches the footer from the slim single row to the
tall marketing layout, with `brand`, `description` and `action` in a leading column.

props.name: description
props.description: A line about the product, under the brand in the tall layout.

props.name: legal
props.description: Bottom row beside the copyright — privacy, terms, a locale switcher.

props.name: meta
props.description: Trailing meta row (badges, “powered by”, etc.).

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Render each link (e.g. Next.js `<Link>`). Defaults to `<a>`.

props.name: social
props.description: Social icon links, under the description.

SiteNav.description:
Marketing-site navbar: fixed bar, brand, desktop links, and a 3-line mobile menu.

Transparent at rest so a hero can run under it; past 20px of scroll it becomes a frosted
bar (`.spk-site-nav` recipe) that stays opaque where backdrop-filter is unavailable, under
`prefers-reduced-transparency`, and in the flat Sandhya theme.

props.name: contained
props.description:
Pin the bar to a relatively positioned parent instead of the viewport.
Use this in docs previews and embedded shells.

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the inner max-width row.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Render each link (e.g. Next.js `<Link>`). Defaults to `<a>`.

props.name: shape
props.description: `text` renders a line at body height; `circle` for avatars.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Defines a string value that labels the current element.
Accessible name for the thumb when there is no visible label.

props.name: getValueText
props.description: Formats `aria-valuetext` (e.g. currency).

props.name: labels
props.description: Category labels for hover tooltips (mood pulse, KPI cards).

props.name: onAiSelectionAction
props.deprecated: Prefer `onAiCommand` for preset actions and free-form prompts.

props.name: customThemes
props.description: Custom themes from `createTheme`. Switch them with `setTheme(id)`.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Uncontrolled initial theme. Ignored when `storageKey` already has a value.

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Persist the selected theme in `localStorage` under this key.
Pass `false` (default) to keep the theme in memory only.

props.name: syncDocument
props.description:
When true (default), also sync theme classes onto `document.documentElement`
so CSS variables apply globally (typical SPA / Storybook usage).

props.name: target
props.description: Optional element to theme instead of (or in addition to) document

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme

props.name: hideBackdrop
props.description: Hide the dimmer behind actions.

SplitFeature.description:
One beat of the alternating product story — copy on one side, a visual on the other.
Stack several with `SplitFeatureGroup` and the sides alternate for you.

On phones the copy always comes first, whatever `reverse` says, so the page still
reads top to bottom in the order you wrote it.

props.name: actions
props.description: Link or button under the copy.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading level.

props.name: bullets
props.description: Short proof points under the copy, each with a check.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small accent label above the title.

props.name: media
props.description: Screenshot, `ShowcaseFrame`, chart or illustration.

props.name: mediaWidth
props.description: Give the media more of the row.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Put the media first on wide screens. Stacking order on phones never changes.

SplitFeatureGroup.description: Stacks `SplitFeature`s with generous spacing and alternates their sides.

props.name: children
props.description: `SplitFeature` elements. Every other one is flipped automatically.

props.name: startReversed
props.description: Start with the media on the left instead of the right.

StatBand.description:
Proof numbers in a row — uptime, customers, latency. Values use tabular figures so
they stay aligned, and the row collapses to two columns on phones.

props.name: variant
props.description: `plain` — numbers on the page · `divided` — hairlines between · `cards` — boxed.

StatCard.description: Metric in a card. For strips of several KPIs prefer `MetricGroup`.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change vs. comparison period (fraction for percent, e.g. `0.12`).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`app` — bordered card, label then value.
`metric` — centred value-first tile for marketing stats.

StepFlow.description:
Numbered "how it works" sequence. Renders an ordered list, so the order is real for
screen readers rather than implied by the connector line.

props.name: connected
props.description: Draw the connector between steps.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` reads as a walkthrough; `horizontal` as a three-beat "how it works".

SurfaceCard.description:
Hierarchy surface: primary (raised) → secondary (subtle) → detail (default) → tertiary (dashed).
Prefer `<Card surface>` in new code.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Border + radius around the scroll container.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height / cell padding. Inherits `data-density` from ancestors when unset.

props.name: hover
props.description: Row hover highlight.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Header sticks while the container scrolls (give the container a max-height).

props.name: numeric
props.description: Right-aligns and uses tabular numerals.

props.name: sortDirection
props.description: Current sort for this column. Pass `onSort` to make the header a sort button.

props.name: variant
props.description: `line` — underline with prism rail (default). `segmented` — contained toggle.

TagInput.description:
Free-form multi-value field (emails, labels, keywords). Tags are committed with Enter or
a comma, pasted lists are split, and Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag.
Arrow keys move between chips; Delete / Backspace on a chip removes it.

props.name: addOnBlur
props.description: Commit pending text when the field loses focus. Default true.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of tags. The field stops accepting input at the limit.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for each chip's remove button.

props.name: separators
props.description: Keys that commit the typed text. Default `["Enter", ","]`.

props.name: validate
props.description:
Return `false` or an error message to reject a tag. Rejected text stays in the field so
it can be corrected; the message is announced to screen readers.

TestimonialCard.description: A customer quote with attribution. Compose several inside a `Grid` or `Marquee`.

props.name: author
props.description: Who said it.

props.name: quote
props.description: The quote itself, without quotation marks — the card draws its own.

props.name: avatar
props.description: An `Avatar`, `InitialsAvatar` or image.

props.name: logo
props.description: Customer logo, shown top-left.

props.name: rating
props.description: A `Rating`, or any small trailing mark.

props.name: role
props.description: Role and company.

props.name: showMark
props.description: Draw the decorative quotation mark.

props.name: size
props.description: `lg` sets the quote at title size — for a single pull quote.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` — hairline surface · `plain` — copy only · `featured` — accent-tinted.

TextField.description: Labeled input (or textarea) with helper / error copy — MUI TextField analogue.

TimelineItem.description: Single activity row inside a Timeline.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon inside the marker. Without one, a small dot is drawn.

Toaster.description: App-level toast host + provider. Wrap the app once and call `useToast()`.

ToolbarButton.description: Compact icon control for the editor toolbar. Avoids a

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Hover intent before a tooltip opens (ms).

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: After a tooltip closes, others in the provider open instantly for this long (ms).

props.name: children
props.description: Middle slot — usually a `SearchTrigger`.

props.name: hideSidebarToggle
props.description: Hide the sidebar toggle (e.g. when the page has no sidebar).

props.name: leading
props.description: Replaces the automatic sidebar toggle.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title or breadcrumb.

TransferList.description: Two-list shuttle for picking items — MUI Transfer List analogue.

TreeView.description:
Hierarchical list (file browsers, org charts, nested navigation) following the WAI-ARIA
tree pattern: one tab stop, ArrowUp / ArrowDown between visible nodes, ArrowRight expands or
enters, ArrowLeft collapses or goes to the parent, Home / End, `*` expands siblings, type-ahead.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Enter or double-click on a node (open a file, navigate).

props.name: children
props.description: `DropdownMenuItem`s rendered in the menu.

props.name: variant
props.description: `row` shows name + email (sidebar footer); `avatar` shows only the avatar (top bar).

ViewFiltersPanel.description:
View & filters panel — glass bottom sheet with clear / done chrome.
Pass arbitrary filter fields as children for full customization.

VirtualList.description:
Windowed list for thousands of rows: only the rows in view (plus `overscan`) are in the DOM.
Rows keep `aria-setsize` / `aria-posinset` so assistive tech reports the full length. The
container is focusable and scrolls with the arrow, Page and Home / End keys.

props.name: height
props.description: Viewport height — a number is pixels.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Fixed row height in pixels.

props.name: endThreshold
props.description: Rows from the end that trigger `onEndReached`. Default 5.

props.name: onEndReached
props.description: Called when the last rows come into view — load the next page here.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Extra rows rendered above and below the viewport. Default 6.

Wordmark.description: Marketing wordmark: solid name, optional gradient accent, optional primary mark.

props.name: name
props.description: Primary name, rendered in foreground.

props.name: accent
props.description: Trailing bit (`.io`, last name) in the marketing gradient.

props.name: mark
props.description: Extra punctuation in primary (the period in `Name.`).

props.name: rest
props.description: Unstyled trailing copy after the mark (`io` in `Sweyam.io`).
